我.o: Pictograph of a weapon with a forked blade and long handle. The meaning "I; me" is a phonetic loan.
w: our, us, i, me, my, we
x: 认识你我真高兴。
Rènshí nǐ wǒ zhēn gāoxìng.
I am pleased to meet you.
我们到时候再说吧。
Wǒmen dàoshíhòu zàishuō ba.
Let's wait and see.
他跟我们不一样。
Tā gēn wǒmen bùyīyàng.
He is different to us.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

們.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 門 represents the sound.

发.o: Simplified form of both 發 (send out) and 髮 (hair). Visually similar to 犮, the bottom component of 髮.
w: to happen; to occur; to take place
to vow; to pledge; to swear
x: 面还没发好。
Miàn háiméi fā hǎo.
The dough has not yet fully risen.
我决不对发生的事情负责。
Wǒ juébù duì fāsheng de shìqing fùzé.
In no way am I responsible for what happened.
这是一个很大的发现。
Zhè shì yīge hěn dà de fāxiàn.
This is a very big discovery.

c.h: Depicts a sharp object poking an eye.

民.o: Pictograph of an eye (目) being poked with something sharp. In ancient China, slaves were sometimes punished by blinding them with a sharp object. Based on the original meaning "slave". The meaning later shifted to "common person".
x: 科技应为人民利益服务。
Kējì yīng wèi rénmín lìyì fúwù.
Science and technology should work for the good of the people.
普及科学与民主，根子在教育。
Pǔjí kēxué yǔ mínzhǔ, gēnzi zài jiàoyù.
Education is at the root of the popularization of science and democracy.

向.o: Depicts a mouth (口) in a closed space (宀) making an echo sound. Based on the original meaning "echo; sound", now written as 響. The meaning later shifted to "direction" and "toward".
w: to face; to turn towards; to incline to
x: 大家纷纷把目光投向他。
Dàjiā fēnfēn bǎ mùguāng tóu xiàng tā.
Everyone cast their gaze towards him.
你要朝那个方向走。
Nǐ yào cháo nà ge fāngxiàng zǒu.
You need to go in that direction.
她朝哪个方向去了？
Tā cháo nǎ ge fāngxiàng qù le?
Which way did she go?

少.o: Depicts four dots, representing the meaning "few". Originally the same character as 小. The small dots possibly represent grains of sand (沙).
w: to lessen; to decrease; to reduce
x: 很少人知道实情。
Hěn shǎo rén zhīdào shíqíng.
Very few people know the truth.
这个班有多少男生？
Zhè ge bān yǒu duōshǎo nánshēng?
How many boys are in this class?
这至少需要有人先出来带个头才行啊。
Zhè zhìshào xūyào yǒu rén xiān chūlái dài ge tóu cái xíng a.
At least someone needs to come out and take the lead.

c.h: Remnant from the top part of 今.
Depicts a metal axe.
Depicts two metal plates.

金.o: Phonosemantic compound. 王 and 吕 represent the meaning and 今 represents the sound. 王 depicts a metal axe and 吕 depicts two metal plates.
x: 他被奖励了一块金表。
Tā bèi jiǎnglì le yīkuài jīn biǎo.
He received a gold watch as a prize.
计划因资金不足而流产。
Jìhuà yīn zījīn bùzú ér liúchǎn.
The plan fell through due to a shortage of funding.
对不起，我们只收现金。
Duìbùqǐ, wǒmen zhǐ shōu xiànjīn.
Sorry. We only accept cash.

科.o: Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the sound and 斗 represents the meaning. Depicts measuring out grain (禾) with a dipper (斗).
x: 这样做很科学。
Zhèyàng zuò hěn kēxué.
This is a very scientific way of doing it.
科技应为人民利益服务。
Kējì yīng wèi rénmín lìyì fúwù.
Science and technology should work for the good of the people.
事实上，我们在科研方面远远超过他们。
Shìshíshàng, wǒmen zài kēyán fāngmiàn yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò tāmen.
As a matter of fact, we are far ahead of them in scientific research.

c.h: ⺮ is a component form of 竹. The original connection of this component to "laugh" is unclear.

笑.o: Phonosemantic compound. ⺮ represents the meaning and 夭 represents the sound.
w: to play a joke; to make fun of; to joke
x: 昨天发生了一件可笑的事。
Zuótiān fāshēng le yī jiàn kěxiào de shì.
A funny thing happened yesterday.
别开他的玩笑了。
Bié kāi tā de wánxiào le.
Don't make fun of him.

c.h: 攵 is a component form of 攴.

救.o: Phonosemantic compound. 攵 represents the meaning and 求 represents the sound.
w: to save sb's life; (interj.) Help!; Save me!
to save; to support; to help
to help sb in trouble; aid; assistance
x: 只有社会主义能够救中国。
Zhǐyǒu shèhuìzhǔyì nénggòu jiù Zhōngguó.
Only socialism can save China.
来人啊！救命啊！
Láirén a! Jiùmìng a!
Someone please! Help!
抢救无效。
Qiǎngjiù wúxiào.
All rescue measures proved ineffectual.

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

近.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 斤 represents the sound.
w: to approach; to get close to
in the past few days; recently
near in time; in the near future; very soon
x: 住越近越容易迟到。
Zhù yuè jìn yuè róngyì chídào.
Those who live closer (to the destination) are more likely to be late.
这是最近一期的《读者》。
Zhè shì zuìjìn yī qī de “Dúzhě”.
This is the latest issue of Duzhe.
新建的市场就在我家附近。
Xīn jiàn de shìchǎng jiù zài wǒ jiā fùjìn.
The newly built market is right near my house.

跑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 包 represents the sound.
w: to flee from sth; to run away; to escape
racing bicycle; sporting bicycle; sports car
to run around all over the place
x: 他去跑步流了一身汗。
Tā qù pǎobù liú le yī shēn hàn.
He is drenched in sweat after running.
我参加了跑步比赛，我的腿很疼。
Wǒ cānjiā le pǎobù bǐsài, wǒ de tuǐ hěn téng.
My legs are sore from participating in a running competition.

耑.o: Pictograph of the roots and leaves of a plant, i.e. the extremities of a plant.

c.h: ⺼ is a component form of 肉.
Shorthand for the phonetic 𡿺 component in the traditional character 腦.

脑.o: Simplified form of 腦. Phonosemantic compound. ⺼ represents the meaning and 𡿺 represents the sound.
x: 我试用新电脑。
Wǒ shìyòng xīn diànnǎo.
I tried out the new computer.
他脑子有病。
Tā nǎozi yǒubìng.
He's out of his mind.
电脑屏幕上有一层灰。
Diànnǎo píngmù shàng yǒu yī céng huī.
There's a layer of dust on the computer screen.

黑.o: Pictograph of a person whose face has been tattooed, now written as 墨. In ancient China criminals were punished by having their faces permanently marked. Later writers reanalyzed the character as a chimney being blackened by fire, so the bottom component was written to look like 炎 (flame).
黑.om: tattoo the face for a crime committed
w: black and white; right and wrong; monochrome
x: 这么黑，我看不见。
Zhème hēi, wǒ kàn bù jiàn.
It's so dark; I can't see.
他们被人驱赶进入一个黑暗的地牢。
Tāmen bèi rén qūgǎn jìnrù yī ge hēi'àn de dìláo.
They were driven into a dark dungeon.
她很怕黑。
Tā hěn pà hēi.
She is very afraid of the dark.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
Depicts two feet (舛) on top of a tree (木).

傑.o: Originally written as 桀, which depicts two feet (舛) on top of a tree (木). 亻 (person) was later added to the character as a meaning component. Based on the original meaning, "to be elevated". The meaning later shifted to "outstanding person" and "hero".

w: to go online; to connect to the Internet
x: 我的网断了。
Wǒ de wǎng duàn le.
My Internet stopped working.
网络错误，请稍后重试。
Wǎngluò cuòwù, qǐng shāohòu chóngshì.
Network error. Please try again later.
视频在网络流传。
Shìpín zài wǎngluò liúchuán.
The video circulated on the Internet.

c.h: Depicts an eye.

监.o: Simplified form of 監. Depicts a person (人) looking (臣) at his own reflection on a plate (皿).
w: to control; to supervise; to inspect
to monitor; to keep a close watch over
to oversee; to take charge of; to supervise
x: 他去监狱看望他爸爸。
Tā qù jiānyù kànwàng tā bàba.
He visited his dad in prison.
我一辈子都被妈妈监视。
Wǒ yībèizi dōu bèi māma jiānshì.
Mum has kept tabs on me all my life.
窃贼事先挡住了监控。
Qièzéi shìxiān dǎngzhù le jiānkòng.
The thief covered the security camera in advance.

c.h: Depicts a person standing up, holding onto a staff, with their mouth open and looking to the side.
龰 is a component form of 止.

疑.o: Pictograph of a person holding onto a staff, looking to the side with his mouth open, doubtful of which direction to go. The 龰 (foot) component was added later to indicate movement, and the 牛 component was added to hint at the sound.
w: to doubt (sth); to be skeptical of
x: 毫无疑问，他是被谋杀的。
Háowúyíwèn, tā shì bèi móushā de.
He was murdered, without a doubt.
你在被无可质疑地证明有罪之前，都是清白的。
Nǐ zài bèi wúkě zhìyí dì zhèngmíng yǒuzuì zhīqián, dōu shì qīngbái de.
You are innocent until proven guilty beyond reasonable doubt.

c.h: Depicts a swirl of clouds.

云.o: Depicts a swirl of clouds up (上) in the sky.
w: the clouds; cloud layer; cloud bank
x: 真给你云完了！
Zhēn gěi nǐ yún wán le!
You're such an armchair expert!
今天一天都是多云天。
Jīntiān yītiān dōu shì duōyún tiān.
It is cloudy the whole day today.

c.h: Shorthand for the phonetic 尌 (shù) component in the traditional character 樹.

树.o: Simplified form of 樹. Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 尌 represents the sound.
x: 树木每年都重新长出叶子。
Shùmù měi nián dōu chóngxīn zhǎngchū yèzi.
The trees renew their foliage every year.
鸟儿落在树枝上。
Niǎo'ér luò zài shùzhī shàng.
The bird lands on the branch

村.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 寸 represents the sound.
x: 他们都来自农村。
Tāmen dōu láizì nóngcūn.
They are all from the countryside.
村民全体去首都抗议新法令。
Cūnmín quántǐ qù shǒudū kàngyì xīn fǎlìng.
The villagers went en masse to the capital to protest the new regulation.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

休.o: Depicts a person (亻) resting under a tree (木).
w: to take a vacation; to go on holiday
x: 有人需要休息。
Yǒurén xūyào xiūxī.
Someone needs to rest.
他休息了一会儿。
Tā xiūxi le yīhuìr.
He rested for a while.
早点休息。
Zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
Go to bed early.

c.h: 虍 is a component form of 虎.
Shorthand for the 思 component in the traditional character 慮.

虑.o: Simplified form of 慮. Phonosemantic compound. 思 represents the meaning and 虍 represents the sound.
w: to think over; to consider; consideration
x: 为什么我的父母从来不为我考虑？
Wèishénme wǒ de fùmǔ cónglái bù wèi wǒ kǎolǜ?
Why don't mum and dad ever take me into consideration?
老师，我有一个疑虑，想请教您。
Lǎoshī, wǒ yǒu yīge yílǜ, xiǎng qǐngjiào nín.
Teacher, I have a misgiving that I would like to ask you about.
这是我管的事，你就不用考虑了。
Zhè shì wǒ guǎn de shì, nǐ jiù bùyòng kǎolǜ le.
I'm taking care of it — you don't need to worry about it.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

剑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 佥 represents the sound. Simplified form of 劍.
w: lit. with swords drawn and bows bent (idiom); fig. a state of…
x: 墙上挂着一把古老的剑。
Qiáng shàng guà zhe yī bǎ gǔlǎo de jiàn.
An ancient sword hangs on the wall.
他从小就开始学击剑。
Tā cóngxiǎo jiù kāishǐ xué jījiàn.
He started learning fencing when he was little.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

挑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 兆 represents the sound.
w: a load carried on the shoulders; to carry
to provoke; to stir up; to incite
to provoke; to entice; to lure
x: 不要挑战我的底线！
Bùyào tiǎozhàn wǒ de dǐxiàn!
Don't test my limit!
那家店有很多家具可供挑选。
Nà jiā diàn yǒu hěn duō jiājù kě gōng tiǎoxuǎn.
That store has a good selection of furniture.
他这个人很挑剔。
Tā zhège rén hěn tiāoti.
He is so nitpicky.

姑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 古 represents the sound.
x: 她是个漂亮的姑娘。
Tā shì ge piàoliang de gūniáng.
She's a good-looking girl.
我们家姑娘已经许了人家儿了。
Wǒmen jiā gūniang yǐjīng xǔ le rénjiar le.
Our miss has already been betrothed.

c.h: Modern form looks like 开.
刂 is a component form of 刀.

刑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 井 represents the sound.
w: limited term of imprisonment (i.e. anything less than life…
x: 应该废除死刑吗？
Yīnggāi fèichú sǐxíng ma?
Should the death penalty be abolished?
废除死刑是原谅杀人犯。
Fèichú sǐxíng shì yuánliàng shārénfàn.
To abolish the death penalty is to excuse murder.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

绑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 邦 represents the sound. Simplified form of 綁.
w: to kidnap; to abduct; to hijack
x: 在被绑架的那些日子里，他过著如噩梦一般的生活。
Zài bèi bǎngjià de nàxiē rìzi lǐ, tā guò zhe rú èmèng yībān de shēnghuó.
Those days when he was kidnapped were a nightmare.
在被绑架的那些日子里，他过着如噩梦一般的生活。
Zài bèi bǎngjià de nàxiē rìzi lǐ, tā guò zhe rú èmèng yībān de shēnghuó.
Those days when he was kidnapped were a nightmare.

筑.g: short name for Guiyang 貴陽|贵阳[Guì​yáng]
筑.o: A strong 巩 bamboo ⺮ building; ⺮ also provides the pronunciation
x: 这建筑看上去有些年头了。
Zhè jiànzhù kàn shàngqù yǒuxiē niántóu le.
This building looks old.
艾菲尔铁塔是巴黎的标志性建筑。
Àifēi'ěr Tiětǎ shì Bālí de biāozhìxìng jiànzhù.
The Eiffel Tower is Paris's landmark structure.

c.h: ⻏ is a component form of 邑.
Shorthand for the 奠 component in the traditional character 鄭.

郑.o: Simplified form of 鄭. Phonosemantic compound. ⻏ represents the meaning and 奠 represents the sound.
x: 他郑重地向大家道歉。
Tā zhèngzhòng de xiàng dàjiā dàoqiàn.
He solemnly apologized to everyone.
郑州是河南的省会。
Zhèngzhōu shì Hénán de shěnghuì.
Zhengzhou is the capital of Henan Province.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

滑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 骨 represents the sound.
x: 这个公司报亏损之后，价格就下滑。
Zhè ge gōngsī bào kuīsǔn zhīhòu, jiàgé jiù xiàhuá.
The price went down after the company reported a loss.
小心地滑。
Xiǎoxīn dì huá.
Caution — slippery when wet.

骑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 马 represents the meaning and 奇 represents the sound. Simplified form of 騎.
x: 阿瑟是一位光芒万丈的骑士。
Āsè shì yī wèi guāngmángwànzhàng de qíshì.
Arthur is a knight in shining armor.
北京的春天很适合骑车逛胡同。
Běijīng de chūntiān hěn shìhé qíchē guàng hútòng.
Beijing’s spring is very suitable for cycling around the hutongs.
路上坑坑洼洼的，骑车的人一不小心就有致命危险。
Lùshàng kēngkēngwāwā de, qíchē de rén yībùxiǎoxīn jiù yǒu zhìmìng wēixiǎn.
Pot holes can be lethal for the unwary cyclist.

c.h: speech

译.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 睪 represents the sound. Simplified form of 譯.
w: to break a code; to crack a riddle
transliteration (rendering phonetic value, e.g. of English words…
x: 会议室设置了同步翻译的设备。
Huìyìshì shèzhì le tóngbù fānyì de shèbèi.
The conference room is equipped with synchronous translation facilities.
我需要一位口译员。
Wǒ xūyào yī wèi kǒuyìyuán.
I need an interpreter.

鮑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 魚 represents the meaning and 包 represents the sound.

丑.o: Depicts of a hand or paw with fingernails or claws. The current meaning is a phonetic loan. In simplified Chinese 丑 is also used to mean "ugly", while in traditional Chinese this meaning is written with a separate character 醜.
x: 这狗长得真丑。
Zhè gǒu zhǎnɡ de zhēn chǒu.
This dog is so ugly.
人丑就该多读书。
Rén chǒu jiù gāi duō dúshū.
Ugly people should read more books.

c.h: 刂 is a component form of 刀.

劑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刂 represents the meaning and 齊 represents the sound.

c.h: 彳 is a component form of 行.

徑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 彳 represents the meaning and 巠 represents the sound.

c.h: cart

x: 这是什么逻辑？
Zhè shì shénme luójí?
What kind of logic is that?

c.h: Depicts the leaves from the mulberry trees. Modern form looks like unrelated 叒.

桑.o: Depicts the leaves of a mulberry tree (木). The leaves from a mulberry tree were the food silkworms would eat.
w: great changes; ups and downs; vicissitudes
lit. the blue sea turned into mulberry fields (idiom)
x: 运动以后他喜欢去蒸桑拿。
Yùndòng yǐhòu tā xǐhuan qù zhēng sāngná.
After exercising he likes to go to the sauna.
这座古城经历了百年沧桑。
Zhè zuò gǔchéng jīnglì le bǎi nián cāngsāng.
This ancient city has been through a century of ups and downs.

c.h: Depicts a head on top of a person.

频.o: Depicts a person standing (页) on the shore wading (涉) in shallow water. Based on the original meaning "riverside", now written as 瀕. The meaning later shifted to "continuous" and "repeatedly".
x: 视频在网络流传。
Shìpín zài wǎngluò liúchuán.
The video circulated on the Internet.
这个视频有毒，我一进去就出不来了。
Zhège shìpín yǒudú, wǒ yī jìnqù jiù chū bù lái le.
This video is very engaging. Once I click on it, I can't get out (stop watching it).

憑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 心 represents the meaning and 馮 represents the sound.

樑.o: A wooden 木 beam 梁; 梁 also provides the pronunciation

閑.o: A wooden fence 木 with a door 門

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

扑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 卜 represents the sound. Simplified form of 撲.
w: (onom.) sound of object falling into water
lit. sth hits one in the face
x: 小狗高兴地扑到我身上。
Xiǎogǒu gāoxìng de pū dào wǒ shēnshang.
The puppy happily jumped up on me.
晚饭后我们一起打扑克吧。
Wǎnfàn hòu wǒmen yīqǐ dǎ pūkè ba.
Let's play cards together after dinner.

惑.o: An uncertain 或 heart 心; 或 also provides the pronunciation
w: to entice; to lure; to induce
to puzzle; to confuse; to baffle
to dispel doubts; to clear up confusion
x: 你就别妖言惑众了，弄得人心惶惶。
Nǐ jiù bié yāoyánhuòzhòng le, nòng de rénxīnhuánghuáng.
Don't spread fallacies to deceive people. It is making everyone feel jittery.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

鑑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 監 represents the sound.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

撑.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 掌 represents the sound. Simplified form of 撐.
w: to prop up; to support; strut
to make oneself do sth in spite of adversity, pain etc
to keep up appearances; to put up a front
x: 他用了双手撑着下巴。
Tā yòng le shuāngshǒu chēng zhe xiàbā.
He used both his hands to prop up his chin.
爸爸失去了工作，一家人的生活全靠妈妈支撑。
Bàba shīqù le gōngzuò, yījiārén de shēnghuó quán kào māma zhīchēng.
Dad lost his job, so the whole family had to be supported by mum.
他用了双手撑著下巴。
Tā yòng le shuāngshǒu chēng zhe xiàbā.
He used both his hands to prop up his chin.

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.
